owner.name: Abdulrahman Bahjat
owner.title: Mechanical Engineer & Aerospace Systems Developer
owner.tagline: Building bridges between physical systems and intelligent software.
owner.about: I am a Mechanical Engineering graduate with a passion for Aerospace systems, Robotics, and Software Architecture. I design and build systems that operate at the intersection of precision hardware and intelligent code — from autonomous robotics platforms to aerospace simulation environments.
goals: Contribute to next-generation autonomous flight systems
Bridge the gap between mechanical engineering and intelligent software
Build open-source tools for the robotics community

experience.description: Developed simulation frameworks for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) flight dynamics. Integrated sensor fusion algorithms with ROS-based autopilot systems.
Delivered custom robotics platforms, automation systems, and full-stack engineering dashboards for clients across the GCC region.

projects.title: Smart Greenhouse
projects.shortDesc: IoT-driven greenhouse with sensor-based climate control and remote monitoring.
projects.fullDesc: An automated greenhouse control system built around a Raspberry Pi controller. A sensor array tracks soil moisture, temperature, humidity, and light; irrigation and ventilation actuators respond automatically, and live telemetry streams to a web dashboard for remote monitoring and manual override.

projects.title: CFD Wing Analysis
projects.shortDesc: High-fidelity CFD analysis of swept wings in transonic flow regimes.
projects.fullDesc: A comprehensive computational fluid dynamics study of NACA swept wing geometries under transonic conditions (Mach 0.8–1.2). Uses ANSYS Fluent with custom Python post-processing pipelines to extract aerodynamic coefficients, pressure distributions, and drag polars.

projects.title: Auto Turret Sentry
projects.shortDesc: Differential drive UGV with computer vision and real-time path planning.
projects.fullDesc: A custom differential-drive unmanned ground vehicle (UGV) equipped with a stereo camera system and a Jetson Nano compute module. Implements A* path planning, YOLOv8 object detection, and real-time telemetry streaming to a React-based control dashboard.

projects.title: Portfolio V1
projects.shortDesc: This very site — a Three.js spatial portfolio with cinematic navigation.
projects.fullDesc: A fully interactive 3D portfolio experience built with React Three Fiber, GSAP, and Zustand. Features a cinematic lift-off sequence, procedurally placed solar system, planet-based project navigation, and a hidden admin panel for static-file updates.

projects.title: Spacecraft Thermal Control
projects.shortDesc: FEA-based thermal analysis and passive cooling design for a CubeSat.
projects.fullDesc: End-to-end thermal analysis of a 3U CubeSat structure in Low Earth Orbit. Uses SolidWorks Simulation for FEA and a custom MATLAB thermal model to verify passive radiator sizing. Designed to keep onboard electronics within operational limits across orbital day/night cycles.
